title: Mitosis OS-process SPEC implementation: the eighteen-MSP stack

completion_criteria.text: The SPEC's admission gate is green before any MSP is cut: every path:line citation in it re-verified against the current tree, with drift corrected.
The A4 Workflow schema question is answered against the live tool path, and if schema enforcement proves already void on main, that defect is fixed and shipped before the rest of the stack.
The scalar fileScope fail-open ships to main as a standalone PR, with planWaves and derive-edges both proven to fail closed and an acceptance test red on the parent commit.
The pathsOverlap glob and canonicalization fail-open ships to main as its own PR, with an acceptance test red on the parent commit and the fix mirrored into the workflows copy in the same commit.
The pre-existing derive-edges defect that wipes edgeReasons on an in-place re-run is fixed and lands on the stack base, with an acceptance test red on the parent commit.
A1's deferred style debt clears in its own commit: runChild under 50 lines and 4 nesting, dispatch.test.mjs under the 800-line cap, suite green and no production behavior changed.
The three termination invariants 0387 filed are guarded on the stack base: liveGroups release, abort-listener removal and drain-timer registration, each independently proven red under mutation.
The orphaned tmux gitlinks that fail actions/checkout under persist-credentials false are untracked and guarded by a closed census, with the three mitosis-gate legs proven green on a real runner.
The receipts enforcer ReDoS is diagnosed to its regex and its trigger escaped on the stack base, with the receipts job proven green on a real runner in 11 seconds.
The two merge non-reconciliations are repaired and merged: SKILL.md:35 restored to B2's pack wording, the --at fixture wrapped in pack, and a delimiter census guarding the ReDoS recurrence.
The C4 chain is restacked onto the merged base with only each branch's own commits replayed, every tree byte-equal to its pre-rebase value, and PR #105 returned to mergeable.
Every home-grown verification mandate is retired across all four layers, receipts/gates@1.1 is on main as the sole standard, and the enforcer is bound to demand a receipt on MSP PRs.
The raw control byte at determinism-lint.mjs:319 is escaped, and a closed census over every tracked non-binary file proves zero raw C0 bytes remain, red on the parent commit.
The four caller-facing spawn sites assert the exec policy before any child starts, a closed census guards against a new unrouted site, and the stale attestation is corrected in the same commit.
A module load failure in the gate closure is framed with the verb and the module that did not load, while runMitosisGate stays synchronous and no existing test block changes signature.
The distrust-of-subagent-results working mode is retired at every editable layer - memory, the delegation rule, and the always-loaded invariant index - with the harness default explicitly outranked.
The C7 obligation inventory is recovered into a base-resident spec, with the seventeen deleted as census collateral reproduced verbatim, and the porting MSP cut against it.
Every MSP in the stack lands as a stacked PR on base feat/mitosis-os-process, each independently green (node --test, lints, every gate verb at that commit), with nothing merged to main.
The silent park filed in 0457 ships as its own MSP: a run document the engine cannot dispatch reports its cause instead of parking indistinguishably, red on the parent commit.
The three structural guarantees each ship a red case proving the gate catches its own violation: exec-allowlist, determinism, dispatchable-agent-schema-capable.
The two deferred classifications close in their named MSPs: redispatch given a determinate home in C7, the three hybrid b2 sites decided per-site in C4, each recorded in its PR body.
D3 publishes the measured comparison against the pre-move baseline, cold and warm cache reported separately, with every cost claim paired with a fixed quality assertion.
The D3 instrument wires end to end: tickDispatcher keeps the envelope, the engine path calls recordUsage, and a run writes a durable per-attempt dispatch record, red on the parent commit.
The evidence-integrity set clears: a billed dispatch never records as unbilled, no observer can lose a line, the summary names runKey and attempt, and usage.jsonl carries one envelope schema.
The confirmed secret-scanner gap reaches main: sk-ant, sk-proj and github_pat all detected, tests red on the parent commit, and the branch pushed and opened as a pull request rather than left parked.
The release gate resolves explicitly: base merges to main only if D3 clears the 10-dispatch-per-shipped-MSP falsifier; a failure is recorded as falsified, never quietly merged.
The receipts gates blocking the shipped stack clear or downgrade honestly: six G14 blocks fixed and verified green in real CI, and the three with no compliant remedy recorded as tracked downgrades.
Every remaining pull request reaches main: 184-187 restacked with 17 stale twins dropped, 184 recovered after a base-branch deletion closed it, 170, 171 and 173 merged, and the trunk green.
Every prompt kind the mitosis flow needs is reachable from the engine entry point on a real run, or is explicitly retired with a recorded reason; no kind stays registered-but-dead.
The engine is audited on live runs against disposable repos, each failure traced to root cause and classed bug or architecture, with a live-usability verdict and minimum change set recorded durably.
The six audit fixes land on one base branch, each with an acceptance test red on its parent and a mutation proof, the merged composition verified green and the fake GitHub binary retired
Both reviewers blocking findings clear before shipping: deletion bound to run ownership and tip containment, shas validated on the destructive path, and the workflow credential exposure closed
Both failure families are audited to root cause with closed state-surface and status-field censuses, every root cause evidenced at path:line, and the whole-solution design left to the next phase.
The pull request tool expresses a bracketed model id verbatim, proven by the tool opening its own fix's PR, with nine injection guards asserted and the sibling-field Markdown exposure filed.

The suite can no longer spawn the real billed claude binary: 19 cli call sites bound behind a closed census, the e2e harness pinned to the sandbox fake by content identity, the PATH fallthrough filed.
The engine opens one pull request per MSP through the centralized pr-create tool on a real run, and serializes merges so the shared branch stays green, proven end to end not by unit test.
A real run exercises the Integrate and Resume phases, including resume after a mid-run teardown, with the journal proving the run resumed rather than restarted.
A real run settles a graph carrying a dependency edge, an induced unit failure, a retry, a park and a poisoned-lock recovery, each reaching its correct terminal state.
An automated end-to-end test covers decompose through pull request against a disposable substrate and runs in CI, red on a build whose engine cannot reach Ship.
DEFERRED: a scope-fence unit reaches a settled successful state, by conditional checkpointing or by never checkpointing, with an acceptance test red before the fix. Never by tolerating a null sha.
DEFERRED: the run-engine.mjs duplicate implement prompt composers at :324 and :335 are removed as dead code inside a live module, leaving prompt-execute.mjs as the single composer.
The stacked-child retarget fix reaches main: pull request 255 merged, and the harness merge-order shape declaration updated in the same change if the engine pin ever moves past b70536fc.
The four blockers to a trustworthy live run are closed, and the harness is rebuilt into cost-ordered lanes whose cheapest crosses the whole pipeline in seconds at no cost.
Every mitosis test file is classified against the two-part bar with a stated reason, deleted only where both halves fail, and whatever survives is filed as housekeeping rather than correctness.
A live run reaches a merged trunk from a written spec: every declared unit ships, every pull request it opens is green including receipts, and the engine observes CI rather than shrugging.

spine.active_goal: Prove mitosis works live: a spec-to-trunk run whose every opened pull request is green, driven through cost-ordered lanes rather than one long blind wait.
spine.next_step: START WITH THE SMOKE LANE: bash full-e2e.sh --lane smoke costs nothing and takes seconds, and confirms the two merged dispatch fixes behave. No billed lane can run until the provider spend limit resets on 2026-08-22 21:00 UTC unless the user raises it; then run --lane single before --lane full. Two design calls are the user's and both change the next run: whether dependsOn blocks at start or only orders the merge, and whether planning should run concurrently rather than eight minutes per unit.
spine.last_session: 2026-08-20: the merge half completed without losing a stacked child, all four blockers closed, and the harness was rebuilt into three lanes after the user rejected an 80-minute worst case. Two live attempts went red; the second hit a spend limit, exposing two dispatch defects now merged.

open_risks.text: Never let the engine merge a pull request — merge is refused at four independent layers by design, so c28 means serialized ship order plus a blocked-pending-approval handoff
Ship a gh stub in every test fakebin and assert its recorder was written — DEFAULT_FALLBACKS hardcodes an absolute path to gh, so PATH alone does not stop a run reaching the live network
Read the exit code from phase-parity rather than its wording — it HALTS at 42 on an empty phase use-set, and a halt is a failure that reads like a pass
Never trust the restarted flag — it read false on a run that listed every unit pending and nothing shipped, including a unit that had really shipped a pull request
Copy the journal aside before any re-run on the same run document — the engine rewrites it at start, so the prior run's deltas are destroyed rather than appended to
Expect a shipped unit to come back parked on a re-run — the done-oracle still prevents a duplicate pull request, so the risk is lost state rather than a second pull request
A NeedsHuman park does not redispatch through remediation on a plain re-run — tested directly, so remediation needs its own trigger before c30 can be attempted

Prove a merge arrived by asserting its CONTENT is on the base, never by a MERGED label or a SHA — a pull request reported as merged this session was still OPEN, and a squash rewrites commits so a pre-merge SHA fails ancestry on a merge that lost nothing

A merged pull request is not an in-force config change — the global agents, rules, skills and lib all symlink into the primary checkout's working tree, so fast-forward it and grep the live file rather than trusting a MERGED label
Never pass --provenance, --origin, --depends or --changed-lines to pr-create — all four were removed and now exit 2; two dispatches lost a round to the stale form
Compose pr-create values within the measured caps — why max 3, what max 3, verified 8, not-verified 8, each value 200 characters, and why, what and risk must start uppercase and end in a full stop
Read per-check conclusions individually rather than any aggregate — no check is required on main, so a pull request merges on one click over a red check, and one did this session

Expect three gate verbs to census the PRIMARY CHECKOUT from inside any linked worktree — dispatchable-agent-schema-capable, name-integrity and retirement-census, so their local green is evidence about that checkout and not about the commit under test

Run the local G14 replica before pushing rather than after — the enforcer draws its mutation sample only once the pull request exists, so an implementer that finishes at creation never sees its own gate
Treat a fast receipts PASS as a short-circuit and say so — a tests-only or docs-only diff returns PASS in seconds with G14 never refereeing anything, which is not a cleared gate

Stub dispatch explicitly in any test that drives runCli in process — cli.mjs defaults deps.dispatch to the real billed binary, and spawnChild converts the failure into an ordinary verdict so the suite still reads green
Write G14 assertions that pin an exact value before you push — three pull requests in a row survived mutation until a test pinned an exact count instead of asserting not-the-old-value

Dispatch every child with run_in_background false — a background child returns only an id, so a dispatching agent ends its turn narrating that it is holding while nothing ran; what it returns when it DOES finish is trusted, never re-run

Work in a worktree rather than switching the primary checkout — the global rules, CLAUDE.md, skills and agents are symlinks into its working tree, and another session moves it between branches without warning
Read every request.prompt in a run document before executing it — the engine hands that text verbatim to a real child holding its own Bash tool, so the document is the entire blast radius

Discard and redo any run that does not reach quiescence cleanly — a dispatch whose start was recorded but whose finish never arrived leaves no usage line at all, so a torn-down run silently undercounts instead of failing loudly
Clear a poisoned lock with the run-store retire verb — a killed run never breaks its own lock, so the next run on the same spec refuses until an operator intervenes

Assume a new top-level .mjs under lib/mitosis needs no registration, but a new SUBDIRECTORY or non-.mjs file halts the determinism verb — and any clock or randomness read reddens it, so take timestamps as validated arguments
Use command grep -a on any test output — grep here is a shell function wrapping ugrep with -I, so output carrying control bytes is silently skipped as binary with no warning, including under grep -c
Capture a verification command's exit code separately and page the output separately — a background wrapper reported exit 0 this session for a run that actually exited 1

Filter the agent ledger to this project before rendering anything from it — thousands of rows carry a confidential cross-project codename, and an unfiltered count or cwd histogram leaks it into a tracked artifact
Remove a worktree before deleting its branch and prune afterwards — git refuses to delete a worktree-held branch, and orphaned worktree gitlinks have failed actions/checkout on this repo before

Expect G11 to block any unit that deletes test files — the pr-create tool renders every value as a bullet, so the enforcer never sees a bare test-removal line and the deletion is recorded as a tracked downgrade
Treat any hand-built reference inventory as a hypothesis — three in a row came back short because the search could not see raw-text pins, reader-side references or multi-line imports
Run the inertness mutation on every unit without exception — each one is fixing vacuity and can reproduce vacuity inside its own fix

Keep all four ladder tags out of every pull request body — the enforcer matches them as plain text and short-circuits all eight re-run gates, so an honest disclosure suppresses the check that would have caught it
Never let ship-with-downgrade excuse breaking the target branch — it covers a verification gap only, and no agent can waive a user-level invariant on another agent's word
MITOSIS_LIVE_GH_TOKEN is still absent, so live-github-substrate has failed all ten runs on main — c31's runs-in-CI half stays unproven and the check cannot be made required
Run the smoke lane before any billed lane — it crosses the whole pipeline in seconds for nothing and its red is definitive, while its green says nothing about live behaviour

Expect every dispatched child to fail with HTTP 429 until the provider spend limit resets on 2026-08-22 21:00 UTC — the account crossed its monthly cap mid-run, so any billed lane reproduces that failure exactly

Decide whether dependsOn blocks a unit from starting or only orders its merge, before the next live run — the decomposer linked two units that merely share a file, so one rejected child took out two units
Expect roughly eight minutes of sequential planning per unit before the journal exists — prep runs entirely before the first journal byte, so a healthy four-unit run looks dead for half an hour
